# Maya Ellison — Chief Technology Officer, Novaflow

- **Goes by:** Maya
- **Full name:** Maya Ellison
- **Role:** Chief Technology Officer (CTO), member of the executive team.
- **Company:** [Novaflow](../context/company.md) — B2B SaaS; a workflow-automation and
  data-pipeline platform for mid-market enterprises (~1,900 customers, ~380 employees,
  Series C, ~$74M ARR).
- **Reports to:** [Daniel Reyes](../people/daniel-reyes.md), CEO & co-founder.
- **Tenure:** joined Novaflow as CTO in early 2023; previously VP Engineering at a
  larger infra company.

## Mandate
Own all of engineering, platform, data, and security. Accountable to the board for
reliability, security posture (SOC 2), the platform re-architecture, and the technical
side of the [Falcon](../projects/falcon.md) initiative. Maya runs a ~150-person
technology org across four groups: Engineering ([Sam Okafor](../people/sam-okafor.md)),
Platform ([Raj Patel](../people/raj-patel.md)), Data ([Nadia Hassan](../people/nadia-hassan.md)),
and Security ([Sam Whitfield](../people/sam-whitfield.md)).

## Current top priorities (2026 H2)
1. **Reliability** — hit the contractual 99.95% SLA; the [Meridian](../projects/meridian.md)
   program is the vehicle and it is currently **at risk**.
2. **Platform re-architecture** — land [Atlas v2 Platform](../projects/atlas-v2-platform.md)
   GA so the [Atlas Migration](../projects/atlas-migration.md) can finish.
3. **Security & compliance** — close [Sentinel](../projects/sentinel.md) (SOC 2 Type II).
4. **Falcon** — technical due diligence and integration planning (confidential).

## What's eating Maya's time
- Firefighting reliability regressions since the June SLA breach.
- Filling the open **Payments EM** role after [Tom Becker](../people/tom-becker.md) departed.
- Board prep — the Q3 technology review is coming up.
- Falcon diligence pulling ~1 day/week.

## Working style
- Deeply technical; wants the "why," not just status. Comfortable reading design docs,
  incident timelines, and architecture diagrams.
- Bias to written pre-reads over live status meetings.
- Protective of maker time — guards Tuesday/Thursday deep-work blocks.
